description: Components for a three-step study planner: intake form, study-preference options, and a weekly schedule.

Form.description: Top-level container for an input surface.

TextField.description: Single-line or multi-line text input bound to the data model.

AssignmentList.description: Repeating rows of assignments (name, course, dueDay, dueTime, hours). Users can add and remove rows.

properties.value: { path: string } binding to an array of assignments

ChoiceGroup.description: A set of OptionCards. mode 'single' stores one optionId, 'multi' stores an array of optionIds.

OptionCard.description: One selectable option inside a ChoiceGroup.

Button.description: Sends a named action (with the surface data model) back to the agent. Disabled until every path in 'requires' has a value.

properties.title: string
properties.subtitle: string
properties.children: string[] of ScheduleSummary / WarningBanner / DayColumn ids

DeadlineBadge.description: Marks a due date inside a day.

WarningBanner.description: Shown only when the workload does not fit or input is incomplete.
